exposure: Twin-twin transfusion syndrome, twin anaemia-polycythaemia sequence, selective fetal growth restriction, twin reversed arterial perfusion sequence, monoamniotic twins, intrauterine death of one monochorionic twin
outcome: Perinatal morbidity and mortality, twin pregnancy complications
cohort: Women with monochorionic twin or higher order multiple pregnancies.
finding: This guideline provides evidence-based recommendations for the management of monochorionic twin pregnancies, aiming to improve outcomes by promoting early identification and optimal management of complications.
